checks.details: Actual human labels contain 152 unique Train sequences, 704 phrases, 9 omitted attributes, 567 unique CLIP strings including Empty/object, and 130 fit / 22 development. Source preparation loads groundtruth.txt; load_inputs computes candidate box IoUs; batch removes iou from model inputs. Current candidate identity/attribute labels and Test/CDTB/VOT optimization inputs are absent.

The standalone 131->64->1 head has 8,512 parameters with bias-free zero-initialized final layer. Exactly 91,395 parent text-interaction parameters plus this head are trainable (99,907). Old semantic/phrase readouts are zeroed and frozen; visual selection and quality stay frozen. Full-minus-zero-semantic score is centered across candidates and added to the visual Parent score.

Relative CE normalizes GT IoU mass only for candidates with IoU>=0.5; no-good rows contribute zero rather than fabricated positives. Preservation uses the detached actual Parent argmax when its GT IoU>=0.5 and protects its score gaps against candidates with GT IoU<=0.1. IoU supervises localization, not physical identity or attribute truth.

All three arms start fresh with seed2027 and the same Parent/head initialization, bank, AdamW lr3e-4, batch64, and fixed final checkpoint after 12 epochs / 480 updates. Per-epoch sample order is seed2027+epoch. Each arm has three-update sanity in a separate process before its 480-update training; sanity weights are not reused.

Source checks finite loss/gradients and outputs, nonzero text/head gradient in the final sanity update, frozen parameters/buffers, all3039 Empty scores/quality exact before versus after, per-batch visual scores exact, nonempty quality unchanged, all selected fields consistent, and state-dict serialization roundtrip. These are implementation checks, not a claimed M115 runtime pass.

Fixed Train development events are evaluated against GT IoU with group metrics and matched own-Empty comparisons. No checkpoint selection, automatic promotion, tracker-history commit, template-update threshold reuse, recursive benchmark, or official metric is implemented here.

Human BCE/choice sanity pair precedes their full pair on GPUs0/1; generic sanity then full training run on GPU0. Any nonzero child exit stops progression, with logs preserved and no retry. Deployment checks previous M114 terminal state, protected bank/label/Parent bindings and existing reviewed dependency bytes before the one launch. The observation helper waits until launch+240s, makes one observation, and copies artifacts only after driver.exit0 plus terminal suite status. Recount keeps .pt files private and checks recorded GT-event summaries, label splits, own-Empty statistics and final checkpoint hashes.

Directly read/recounted M113/M114 and M47 evidence agrees with the plan. Human M113 and Empty both hit272/495, with only0.0000029844617603 mean-IoU increment. M114 human development common energy is92.18241788865826%; good/poor margins improve19 and shrink204 of223. The 190 no-good development states concern the10-candidate set, not all256 locations/crop coverage. M47 auxiliary cross-frame multi-positive matching retained default-priority action targets and failed its completed recursive gate.

The plan does not infer a unique causal BCE failure from M113/M114, does not label poor-localization boxes as different physical instances, discloses changed Parent preservation versus M113, and limits the matched loss comparison to the two M115 human arms. No novelty or three-module claim is inferred merely from this head/loss.

Python3.8 AST parsing passed for13 relevant D source files and all3 private helpers, plus3 embedded remote Python blocks. Only pure stdlib reporting functions were extracted in memory:8 existing M113 summaries and4 paired summaries matched. No Torch import, NN forward, optimizer step, SSH operation, credentials access, experiment launch or source mutation was performed by this reviewer.
